description: This Java class 'ContactMechWorker' provides utility methods for managing contact mechanisms within the OFBiz framework, including retrieval, creation, and validation of contact addresses and related entities.

classes.name: ContactMechWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for managing contact mechanisms such as addresses and phone numbers within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: insertRelatedContactElement
methods.description: Adds related contact element GenericValue to elementMap based on contactMechTypeId.

methods.name: getPartyContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism value maps for a party, optionally filtered by contactMechTypeId and date.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism value maps for a facility, optionally filtered by contactMechTypeId and date.

methods.name: getOrderContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms associated with an order.

methods.name: getWorkEffortContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms related to a work effort.

methods.name: getEntityContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve contact mechanisms for a generic entity view, with optional date filtering.

methods.name: getContactMechAndRelated
methods.description: Populates target map with contact mechanism and related entities based on request parameters for a party.

methods.name: getPartyPostalAddresses
methods.description: Returns postal addresses for a party excluding the current contactMechId.

methods.name: getCurrentPostalAddress
methods.description: Returns the current postal address for a party and contactMechId.

methods.name: isUspsAddress
methods.description: Checks if a postal address matches USPS address patterns.

methods.name: isCompanyAddress
methods.description: Determines if a postal address belongs to a specific company party.

methods.name: getContactMechAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value for a contact mechanism.

methods.name: getPostalAddressPostalCodeGeoId
methods.description: Determines the geoId for a postal address based on postal code and country, with caching.

methods.name: urlEncodePostalAddress
methods.description: Converts a PostalAddress GenericValue into a URL-encoded string.
